name: Pennette Pasta (Request Butter & Parmesan Swap)
whyItWorks: Refined white pennette pasta and finely ground beef ragù are easy to chew, though tomato sauce acidity makes it an Everyday/Careful choice unless swapped for butter and parmesan.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy as-is on a good day, or ask your server for the pennette tossed in melted butter, chicken broth, and shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano (~0g lactose) if flaring.
flareEmergencySwap: Order the Black Truffle Pasta Purseittes or plain pennette with butter and parmesan (9.5/10).
